title: Tool library dialog: U1 dialog shell and tools list

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P4
labels.description: Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut

body:
Goal: The Tools ribbon cell opens the tool library in its own non-modal window. The window can stay open beside the viewport. The "Tool library" dock tab goes away.

Parent: #3663. Plan: the implementation plan in the #3663 comment. This is PR U1 of 11.

Files:
- Add `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library_dialog/mod.rs` with `tool_library_window(ctx, state)`. Copy the pattern of `tool_shape_editor_window` in `pages.rs`.
- Add `tool_library_dialog/list.rs`. Move the body of `egui_app/tool_library.rs` there, then delete that file. Keep the labels "Tool type", "Name filter", "New tool…", "Export library…", "Import library…", "Import tool holders" and "Catalog".
- Add `crates/ui/src/state_tool_library_dialog.rs` with `ToolLibraryView`. Add one field to `state.rs`.
- Change `actions.rs` `target()` so that all four doors open the window. Change `shell.rs` and `layout/mod.rs`. Keep the `Tab::Tools` variant, because a saved panel setup can name it.

Tests:
- New: `page_layout_tool_library::layout_window_tool_library` (new file `tests/page_layout_tool_library.rs`).
- New: `panel_setups::a_saved_setup_with_the_old_tool_library_tab_still_loads`.
- Update, do not delete: `tools_ribbon_opens_a_docked_catalog_without_retargeting_properties`, `layout_page_tool_library`, `gate_route_tests.rs`, `tests.rs`, `panel_setups.rs` and the Gate maps in `catalog_filters.rs` and `edm_tool_visibility.rs`. The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` must not go down.

Depends on: nothing.

Commands: none new. "Add" uses `AddTool`. Import uses `ImportTools`. No MCP tool is owed.

Expected quick gate: 10 to about 20 steps. Run `cargo xtask gate quick --dry-run` first.

Done means: each of the four doors opens the "Tool library" window. The window lists Document and Catalog tools. A saved panel setup with the old dock tab still loads. No snapshot PNG changes.

Changelog row: The Tools ribbon cell opens the tool library in its own window, which can stay open beside the viewport. The "Tool library" dock tab is gone.
